messages:
Sam (AE): urgent - Delta Labs POC is blocked. Customer's IdP is rejecting our SAML metadata (EntityID mismatch) and their infra team also says VPC peering is stuck on their side. CISO wants answers to the security questionnaire before we can enable dedicated capacity. Need an exec bridge if we can't unblock today.

Jordan (Sales Eng): digging in — their SAML error is `invalid_entity_id` when our ACS callback hits. Customer sent metadata with entityID `https://id.delta-labs.com/sp` but our SP is `https://redwood.ai/sp`. Might be a metadata config mismatch on their side.

Alex (Solutions): we can add an SP alias for `https://id.delta-labs.com/sp` on our side as a short-term workaround. Will need infra to deploy config + reload. If they need dedicated pool, that's separate (needs billing signoff).

Dean (CS): alias should be fine. Deploy steps: add `sp_alias` entry in sso-config for delta-labs, restart auth-proxy. Est deploy time ~20m once we have approval. Also, VPC peering -> do they want route-based or AWS PrivateLink?

Sam (AE): customer asked for PrivateLink. They claim peering is blocked by their network team until legal signs the DPA addendum. CISO asked for a completed questionnaire (we already shared draft on Friday).

Mia (AE Lead): can we run the alias today without the DPA? Legal said short-term test traffic is allowed under existing NDA for POC, but procurement wants DPA signed for production/dedicated. I'll confirm with legal now.

ops-bot: scheduled deploy window request created (#deploy-4392) — please add owner and ETA.

Jordan (Sales Eng): sample config we can apply quickly: ```
# sso-config delta-labs snippet
sp_aliases:
  - original: "https://redwood.ai/sp"
    aliases:
      - "https://id.delta-labs.com/sp"
```

Alex (Solutions): note — adding alias bypasses metadata mismatch but doesn't validate their assertion consumer URL. We'll need them to confirm ACS URL is `https://redwood.ai/sso/acs` or adjust accordingly. Ping them now for ACS confirmation.

Sam (AE): pinged customer (CISO and infra) — they said ACS is `https://redwood.ai/sso/acs` and will try to re-upload corrected metadata within 2 hours. Asked them to approve short-term alias while they fix metadata.

Dean (CS): can someone from legal confirm DPA quick path? If legal greenlights, we can proceed with PrivateLink. Otherwise we offer temporary internet-facing tunnel for POC (not ideal).

Mia (AE Lead): Legal: "ok for short-term POC alias and limited test traffic under NDA; DPA required for PrivateLink/dedicated capacity." So workaround approved.

Sam (AE): great. Next blockers: pricing — Delta Labs asked for a 6-week POC price cap for dedicated pool (N GPUs). Finance needs to confirm discounting for POCs. @Alex any ideas on how to present?

Alex (Solutions): propose a POC credit proposal: 100k tokens + 1 week dedicated burst included; if they convert to reserved, credit applied to first invoice. Frame as limited-time evaluation credit tied to signed SOW.

Jordan (Sales Eng): I'll draft an SOW amendment w/ credit + explicit rollback to shared hosted model if they don't sign reserved capacity by EOM. Keep it simple.

Sam (AE): customer CISO still expecting security questionnaire answers for SOC2 controls mapping. Dean, can you handle the controls matrix for `network segregation`, `key management`, and `audit logging`? They flagged KMS integration as a blocker.

Dean (CS): on it. Will attach our KMS handshake doc and a short note on encryption-in-transit + at-rest. ETA 4 hours.

Mia (AE Lead): scheduling exec bridge in case their CISO doesn't approve the workaround. Proposed windows: 16:00 or 18:00 PT today. who can join?

Jordan (Sales Eng): I can join 16:00.

Alex (Solutions): 18:00 works for me if needed.

Sam (AE): I'll try 16:00 first. Customer said they'll aim to resolve metadata by then.

ops-bot: deploy #deploy-4392 assigned to Dean (CS) — ETA 22 minutes.

Dean (CS): applied alias and restarted auth-proxy. Quick smoke: auth flow now returns 200 for SAML handshake. Please have customer retry.

Sam (AE): customer retried, reports SAML now passes and they can login via SSO. CISO still wants completed questionnaire but said this unblocks testing.

Mia (AE Lead): status update for execs: SSO fixed via alias (temporary), VPC PrivateLink still blocked pending DPA, security questionnaire in progress (Dean to deliver KMS + audit bits), pricing SOW draft in flight (Jordan + Alex). Next step: monitor for final metadata and DPA signoff — if not signed in 48h, escalate to exec bridge.

Jordan (Sales Eng): adding runbook items to the POC doc: "revert alias once metadata fixed", "record change window", "apply credit if SOW signed".

Sam (AE): Customer followup: CISO expects final questionnaire answers within 24-48h and legal to route DPA by end of week. They appreciate quick turnaround — :thumbsup:. I'll update account exec after Dean's doc is in.

Dean (CS): uploaded KMS and logging notes to the shared folder: https://redwood.app/drive/delta-poc (link). Sent to customer.

Mia (AE Lead): marking this thread as monitoring. Will open exec bridge if DPA not routed within 48h.

Sam (AE): thanks team.
